Notes.Text:
This update for webkit2gtk3 fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-64718: webkitgtk: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash
  (bsc#1277001).
- CVE-2026-65335: webkitgtk: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash
  (bsc#1277015).
- CVE-2026-78376: use-after-free of `JSCValue` function parameters (bsc#1276418).
- CVE-2026-83596: webkitgtk: Validate the full FeatureList array once in OpenTypeVerticalData findFeature (bsc#1277755).

Non security issue fixed:

- libjavascriptcoregtk-4_0-18: JSGlobalContextCreate() aborts on aarch64 64 KB-page kernel (bsc#1285528).
- Build with -DUSE_64KB_PAGE_BLOCK=ON on aarch64 (bsc#1285528).
